visualInspection.notes: Position and orientation of a body; rigid attachment of reference frames; transformations between frames. Diagram shows labeled coordinate frames on manipulator and objects. No printed slide number visible.

Three-column graphic contrasts narrow AI (one specific task), general AI (human-level reasoning across cognitive tasks), super AI (surpasses human intelligence in every domain). Source marker says We are HERE under narrow AI. No printed slide number visible.

SCARA R-R-P-R configuration and 4 DOF; 3 spatial plus 1 orientation. Vertical axes. Table: shoulder ±170 degrees, elbow ±145 degrees, prismatic stroke 0–200 mm, end-effector rotation ±360 degrees. Kinematic diagram labels all four joints/axes. No printed slide number visible.

Open-loop block diagram: trajectory generator sends desired joint position, velocity and acceleration to controller; torque drives robot without feedback. Torque model M(theta_d) theta_ddot_d + V(theta_d,theta_dot_d)+G(theta_d). Source states needs perfect model, no disturbance rejection, stepper motors example. No printed slide number visible.

Hardware perspective sense → think → act: sensors collect environment data (camera, lidar, IMU), compute runs AI (CPU/GPU/MCU), actuators create physical motion (motors, servos). No printed slide number visible.

Noise/uncertainty and Gaussian bell curve. Ten LiDAR scans: 1.98, 2.03, 2.01, 1.97, 2.02, 2.00, 1.99, 2.04, 1.96, 2.01 m; source reports mean approximately2.00 m, sigma approximately0.025 m, report2.00 m ±2.5 cm. Printed slide9 visually confirmed although lecture-relative page11; retain both.
